excerpt: Arcadi Volodos pairs Schubert's Piano Sonata in D major, D. 850 ("Gasteiner") with Schumann's Kinderszenen, Op. 15 in a live recital recorded at the Fondation Louis Vuitton. The two works present contrasting Romantic ideals: a large-scale four-movement sonata of public ambition and an intimate cycle of character pieces. These readings do not, however, displace any primary recommendations in either work.

Karajan's first complete Beethoven cycle, recorded with Walter Legge's Philharmonia Orchestra between 1951 and 1955 and now reissued in a seven-disc box on Warner Classics, captures the conductor before the polished Berlin manner he became known for had taken hold. The Philharmonia readings catch a sharper-edged Karajan, quicker to inflect a phrase and slower to smooth out an accent.
